an4.96:1.1: “Monks, these four types of individuals are to be found existing in the world.
an4.96:1.3: The one who practices for his/her own benefit but not for that of others.
an4.96:1.4: The one who practices for the benefit of others but not for his/her own.
an4.96:1.5: The one who practices neither for his/her own benefit nor for that of others.
an4.96:1.6: The one who practices for his/her own benefit and for that of others.
an4.96:2.1: “And how is one an individual who practices for his/her own benefit but not for that of others?
an4.96:2.2: There is the case where a certain individual practices for the subduing of passion within him/herself but doesn’t encourage others in the subduing of passion;
an4.96:2.3: practices for the subduing of aversion within him/herself but doesn’t encourage others in the subduing of aversion;
an4.96:2.4: practices for the subduing of delusion within him/herself but doesn’t encourage others in the subduing of delusion.
an4.96:2.5: Such is the individual who practices for his/her own benefit but not for that of others.
an4.96:3.1: “And how is one an individual who practices for the benefit of others but not for his/her own?
an4.96:3.2: There is the case where a certain individual doesn’t practice for the subduing of passion within him/herself but encourages others in the subduing of passion;
an4.96:3.3: he/she doesn’t practice for the subduing of aversion within him/herself but encourages others in the subduing of aversion;
an4.96:3.4: he/she doesn’t practice for the subduing of delusion within him/herself but encourages others in the subduing of delusion.
an4.96:3.5: Such is the individual who practices for the benefit of others but not for his/her own.
an4.96:4.1: “And how is one an individual who practices neither for his/her own benefit nor for that of others?
an4.96:4.2: There is the case where a certain individual doesn’t practice for the subduing of passion within him/herself and doesn’t encourage others in the subduing of passion;
an4.96:4.3: he/she doesn’t practice for the subduing of aversion within him/herself and doesn’t encourage others in the subduing of aversion;
an4.96:4.4: he/she doesn’t practice for the subduing of delusion within him/herself and doesn’t encourage others in the subduing of delusion.
an4.96:4.5: Such is the individual who practices neither for his/her own benefit nor for that of others.
an4.96:5.1: “And how is one an individual who practices for his/her own benefit and for that of others?
an4.96:5.2: There is the case where a certain individual practices for the subduing of passion within him/herself and encourages others in the subduing of passion;
an4.96:5.3: practices for the subduing of aversion within him/herself and encourages others in the subduing of aversion;
an4.96:5.4: practices for the subduing of delusion within him/herself and encourages others in the subduing of delusion.
an4.96:5.5: Such is the individual who practices for his/her own benefit and for that of others.
an4.96:5.6: “These are the four types of individuals to be found existing in the world.”
